name: ioc-spyware
description: Spyware / stalkerware / commercial-surveillance indicators — Linux desktop (EvilGnome, logkeys) and Android packages (Pegasus/Chrysaor, TheTruthSpy, Cerberus, SpyMax/SpyNote). For real mobile triage use Amnesty's MVT.  Absent keys/paths SKIP, never false-fail.

rules.title: IOC: EvilGnome spyware artifacts in a home dir
rules.rationale: EvilGnome is Linux desktop spyware (screenshots, audio capture, file exfil) that disguises itself as a GNOME Shell extension and persists via ~/.config/autostart.
rules.fix: If this indicator is unexpected, treat the host as possibly compromised: isolate it, capture the artifacts for analysis, and hunt for persistence.

rules.title: IOC: EvilGnome autostart entry
rules.rationale: The autostart .desktop file EvilGnome drops so its agent relaunches at login.
rules.fix: If this indicator is unexpected, treat the host as possibly compromised: isolate it, capture the artifacts for analysis, and hunt for persistence.

rules.title: IOC: logkeys.log present (/var/log/logkeys.log)
rules.rationale: logkeys is a userspace keylogger; its default logfile here means keystrokes are being recorded.  Dual-use — only benign if you set it up yourself.
rules.fix: If you didn't put logkeys.log there deliberately, treat the host as possibly compromised: isolate it, capture the file for analysis, and hunt for persistence.

rules.title: IOC: logkeys present (/usr/bin/logkeys)
rules.rationale: The logkeys keylogger binary. Legitimate only if you installed it deliberately.
rules.fix: If you didn't put logkeys there deliberately, treat the host as possibly compromised: isolate it, capture the file for analysis, and hunt for persistence.

rules.title: IOC: Pegasus (Chrysaor) package installed
rules.rationale: com.network.android is the documented package name of Chrysaor, the Android build of NSO Group's Pegasus spyware.  For a real mobile-spyware investigation use Amnesty International's MVT.
rules.fix: If this indicator is unexpected, treat the host as possibly compromised: isolate it, capture the artifacts for analysis, and hunt for persistence.

rules.title: IOC: TheTruthSpy stalkerware package installed
rules.rationale: com.systemservice is the package used by the TheTruthSpy stalkerware family, which hides as a fake 'System Service' app.
rules.fix: If this indicator is unexpected, treat the host as possibly compromised: isolate it, capture the artifacts for analysis, and hunt for persistence.

rules.title: IOC: Cerberus (abusable tracker) package installed
rules.rationale: Cerberus is an anti-theft app routinely abused as covert stalkerware (remote mic, location, photos).  Legitimate if YOU installed it as anti-theft; a red flag if you didn't.
rules.fix: If this indicator is unexpected, treat the host as possibly compromised: isolate it, capture the artifacts for analysis, and hunt for persistence.

rules.title: IOC: SpyMax/SpyNote-style RAT service present
rules.rationale: Package names associated with the SpyMax / SpyNote Android RAT builders, common in targeted mobile surveillance.
rules.fix: If this indicator is unexpected, treat the host as possibly compromised: isolate it, capture the artifacts for analysis, and hunt for persistence.

rules.title: IOC: on-device frida app installed
rules.rationale: The frida instrumentation app can hook other apps' memory — legit for researchers, a hooking implant otherwise.  Pairs with the frida-server staging check in Murphy's Android module.
rules.fix: If this indicator is unexpected, treat the host as possibly compromised: isolate it, capture the artifacts for analysis, and hunt for persistence.
